name: hud_cmd_bind_button_base_load_from_zrd
description: HudCmdBindButtonBase::LoadFromZrd loads selected and list font styles, spacing, list offsets, LISTSIZE counts, rebuilds binding slot widgets, and attaches the binding slot panels and selected-entry panel to the owner container.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S comparison is deferred to the Hud command bind button source-file or class cluster.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b8de0 validates the HudUiCheckToggleWidget base load, SELECTED_FONT/LIST_FONT/SPACING/LIST_OFFSET/LISTSIZE ZRD lookups, selected/list font-style table resolution, RebuildBindingSlotWidgets call, owner AddChild calls, SetVisible ftable slot 0x60 dispatch, SetBltSourceAndClipRect ftable slot 0x18 dispatch, owner back-pointers, and final success return.

The native smoke verifies spacing, visible and overflow offsets, LISTSIZE rebuild counts, child attachment through owner back-pointers, binding slot owners, and selected-entry owner after loading. Binary Ninja evidence covers the optional selected/list font and clip-source branches.
